info.title: HoneyHive Universal API
info.description: HoneyHive is an AI observability and evaluation platform for tracing sessions/events, managing datasets, metrics, tools, projects, experiment runs, and configurations through the HoneyHive API.

post.description: Adds datapoints to a dataset in HoneyHive.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

datasetId.description: Dataset ID to add datapoints to.

data[].description: Data rows to add as datapoints.

mapping.description: Mapping for inputs, ground truth, and history.
